signal: equal-weight delta-neutral spot/perp funding carry, 5 coins
return_definition: daily summed funding per coin, averaged across coins, bp/day

benchmark.name: T-bill
benchmark.why: carry competes with cash, not with BTC beta

judgment_gate.rule: no verdict of any kind before both are met

kill_criteria.K1: net CI-LB <= 0 at the pre-registered cost
kill_criteria.K2: realised second-half mean < 60% of the first half
kill_criteria.K4: pledged-collateral yield unavailable AND net < T-bill hurdle
kill_criteria.K5: any single observation < -400 bp -> REVIEW, not auto-kill

known_limitations: one exchange, one venue, no counterparty-risk price
cost is a single measured snapshot treated as a floor; stress widens it
a 60-day floor means the first judgment is impossible before ~2027-01-21
